notes: A 3-block dynamictrees:oak_branch column on a dirt base, chopped at the base with an iron axe. TRUTH (Dynamic Trees felling): the trunk is felled as a whole (FallingTreeEntity), so the branch cells are gone, the drops are oak_log (count from dynamictrees:multiply_logs_count, scales with branch radius) and sticks (branch loot pool), and the seeds are not from branches (seeds come from leaves). Source: dynamictrees data/trees/branches/oak loot table. Shape: one observe blocks box over the column (exact counts). Drops: observe entities around the column; only minecraft:oak_log is compared (a range, since the count scales with the branch radius), sticks are random and ignored (ids filter). Felling of a hand-placed branch column (no leaves, no root) is NOT verified; expected results are the loot table, not a checked felling.
